messages:
hana: FYI: KMS key rotation pushed to prod (us-west-2) at 01:12 UTC. Seeing dozens of GPU node bootstrap failures and private-subnet flow logs appear to drop to a lower sample. Raising @infra-oncall.

samir: seeing same — ~30 nodes failed to attach keystore, kubelet logs show `Failed to get KMS key` on bootstrap.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: kms-rotate-job completed for alias/redwood/prod/usw2 (run id: j-7392) :white_check_mark:

irene: CloudTrail shows `Decrypt` errors from instance role `node-role-prod` between 01:12-01:25. Also VPC flow logs for priv-subnet-3 indicate sample_rate changed to 10%.

andrew: Is sampling change intended? We only toggled sample=10% last month in eu, not us-west. Who flipped privnet sampling?

maya: @irene can you paste the kubelet stderr from a failing node?

irene: ```
2026-03-18T01:14:07Z kubelet: error: KMSDecryptError: AccessDeniedException: Access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
    at kms.Decrypt (keystore.go:123)
```

samir: Also seeing ENI creation timeouts — `CreateNetworkInterface` failing because SG rule references deleted prefix-list PL-EXTERNAL-OLD.

andrew: ah — there was an infra cleanup PR that replaced some SG references and removed PL-EXTERNAL-OLD last week. If SGs point to a non-existent prefix list ENI attach can fail.

hana: So likely two coupled failures: (1) KMS policy/rotation removed grant causing Decrypt errors, (2) SG referencing deleted prefix-list causing ENI attach failures -> nodes don't fully come up -> fewer flow records and CloudTrail entries. Agree?

samir: :thumbsup: sounds right.

maya: Mitigation plan: revert SG change to previous revision, add kms:Decrypt grant for node-role-prod back to key policy, restart kubelet on affected nodes. I can revert the SG in ~5m.

hana: Patch plan: 1) revert SG rule (maya) 2) add kms:Decrypt grant for `node-role-prod` (andrew) 3) restart kubelet on failed nodes (samir) 4) raise flow-log sample to 100% on private subnets for 1h to capture recovery (irene)

andrew: I'll push a temporary policy statement: 
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowNodeDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-role-prod"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Pushing now, will ping when applied.

iam-bot: iam-bot: policy change applied to key abcdef (change-id c-9123) :rocket:

maya: SG revert done (rev 42 -> rev 41). Cluster should be able to create ENIs again.

samir: Restarting kubelet on pending nodes. One node rejoined, logs streaming again. :tada:

irene: Increasing VPC flow log sampling to 100% on priv-subnet-3 and priv-subnet-4 for 1h to capture full recovery trace.

hana: Cost note: sampling -> 100% for 1h adds ~ $20 in flow logs while active — ok for incident.

andrew: Post-incident actions: add PR preflight to block SGs referencing deleted prefix-lists; add KMS rotation dry-run to verify grants to node roles before rotation.

maya: I'll open follow-ups: INFRA-423 (SG preflight), INFRA-424 (KMS dry-run grant).

hana: Assigning INFRA-423 -> andrew, INFRA-424 -> maya. Can we close this thread after 15m stable? Check in 10m.

samir: 10/10 nodes green now, monitoring for 15m.

hana: Closing after 15m stable. :lock:
